top_story.title: The S&P 500 Is Up in September, but Market Breadth Has Been Terrible
top_story.summary: The S&P 500 may narrowly end the month of September with a gain.  The market benchmark is up 0.2% on the month, while the Nasdaq Composite is up 2.4%.  The S&P’s second-consecutive monthly gain included major assists from Meta Platforms and Apple.
